symptom: package-lock.json still declares version 1.8.3 while package.json is at 1.11.0 — the 1.9.0, 1.10.0 and 1.11.0 releases never regenerated it. Surfaced while chasing an external 'Build failed' report.
cause: The release convention bumps `version` in package.json + the McpServer({version}) string, but never runs `npm install` to refresh the lockfile's root version, so the lock's `version` / `packages[""].version` drift behind every release.
fix: Fixed in v1.11.1: ran `npm install --package-lock-only` so the lock root version tracks package.json (now 1.11.1, @xenova/transformers subtree still resolved — the v1.8.3 failure mode), and verified a clean `npm ci` + `npm test` off the regenerated lock. Same release also added a `start` script and put `scripts/` in the `files` whitelist so `npm test` works from an installed package.
